module "Rf_NodeOutputs.dss"

product 0 Material "M_NodeOutputs" backend=Graph
  %0 = Reflected[SceneTexture](SceneTextureId="PostProcessInput0") : [Color:float4, Size:float2, InvSize:float2] @L6:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %1 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L6:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %2 = Swizzle(%0#2, Mask="x") : float @L7:C17 "Opacity"
  %3 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%1, Opacity=%2) @L4:C1
  sink %3
